page.notes: The index is printed in three columns with verse numbers at the left of each entry and page references at the right; the entries run across the column breaks (for example "Iacta super dominū curam tuā" continues at the top of the third column). The entry "Prout fueris ad copiam instrustus benignitatem exerceas" has no page reference printed on its line. "neque quàd Dauidem" is hard to read and may be "quoniam" or similar. Some printed lines of the third column are faint. The running head "INDEX" is set in capitals with an ornament.
